_comment: Flat-pane glazing per vehicle (canopy_panes). base: 'none' (panes only) | 'loft' (canopy_loft dome first, 'loft' holds overrides for it) | 'windscreen' (canopy_loft dome cut open at the windscreen bow, flat panes glaze the windscreen) | 'glass' (canopy_glass dome). eyes: seat indices to glaze from. skip_az: [[az0, az1, el0, el1]] openings meant to stay open (degrees, azimuth positive to the left, 0 ahead). el_min: lowest elevation glazed. tube: fuselage half-width for telling cabin openings from windows.
